welcome.subject: Welcome to {{schoolName}}
welcome.body:
Welcome to {{schoolName}}

Dear {{name}},

Your account has been created successfully.

Login details:
Email: {{email}}
Password: {{password}}

Please log in and change your password on first login.

Best regards,
{{schoolName}} Team

password_reset.subject: Password Reset Request
password_reset.body:
Password Reset

Dear {{name}},

We received a request to reset your password.

Click the link below to reset your password. This link expires in 1 hour.

Reset Password

If you did not request this, please ignore this email.

Best regards,
{{schoolName}} Team

attendance_warning.subject: Attendance Warning - {{studentName}}
attendance_warning.body:
Attendance Warning

Dear {{parentName}},

This is to inform you that {{studentName}}'s attendance has dropped to {{percentage}}%.

Please ensure regular attendance to avoid academic consequences.

Best regards,
{{schoolName}} Administration

exam_result.subject: Exam Results Published - {{examName}}
exam_result.body:
Exam Results

Dear {{name}},

The results for {{examName}} have been published.

You can view your results by logging into the parent/student portal.

Best regards,
{{schoolName}} Administration

fee_reminder.subject: Fee Payment Reminder
fee_reminder.body:
Fee Payment Reminder

Dear {{parentName}},

This is a reminder that the following fee is due:

Fee: {{feeDescription}}
Amount: {{amount}}
Due Date: {{dueDate}}

Please make the payment before the due date to avoid penalties.

Best regards,
{{schoolName}} Finance Department

admission_approved.subject: Admission Approved - {{studentName}}
admission_approved.body:
Admission Approved

Dear {{parentName}},

We are pleased to inform you that {{studentName}}'s admission to {{schoolName}} has been approved.

Please visit the school to complete the enrollment process.

Best regards,
{{schoolName}} Admissions

admission_rejected.subject: Admission Status - {{studentName}}
admission_rejected.body:
Admission Update

Dear {{parentName}},

After careful review, we regret to inform you that {{studentName}}'s admission to {{schoolName}} has been rejected.

Reason: {{reason}}

Best regards,
{{schoolName}} Admissions

payment_receipt.subject: Payment Receipt - {{receiptNumber}}
payment_receipt.body:
Payment Receipt

Dear {{name}},

Your payment has been received successfully.

Receipt Number: {{receiptNumber}}
Amount: {{amount}}
Date: {{date}}
Description: {{description}}

Thank you for your payment.

Best regards,
{{schoolName}} Finance Department

report_card.subject: Report Card Available - {{termName}}
report_card.body:
Report Card Available

Dear {{parentName}},

The report card for {{studentName}} for {{termName}} is now available.

Please log into the parent portal to view and download the report card.

Best regards,
{{schoolName}} Administration

enrollment_request.subject: New Enrollment Request - {{studentName}}
enrollment_request.body:
New Enrollment Request

A new enrollment request has been submitted.

Student: {{studentName}}
Grade: {{grade}}
Submitted: {{date}}

Please review and process the request.

Best regards,
{{schoolName}} System
